_comment: Grantees of The Navigation Fund (Jed McCaleb's foundation) named on navigation.org's program pages, extracted 2026-09-30. The site publishes grantee logos and highlights but no amounts or dates; aggregate giving ($24m to farm animal welfare in 2025) is recorded via fund_estimates. Their Open Science program closed and moved to Astera; nuclear safety giving is via a partnership with Longview Philanthropy and is not itemized here.
